title: What the Probe Saw
summary: Hester has been at the receiver since the probe went up. She's seen him now. Go and hear it, then get ready to go: a Space Helmet, and a Jetpack to keep air in it.

goals.say: She's crying a little, and doesn't seem to notice. 'He's real. Thirty years, and he's real.'
goals.name: Hester Quill

goals.say: Helmet, air, fuel for the way home. Hester makes you say it back to her twice.

threats.name: Hester Quill
threats.target_line: Come here. Come here and look at what your little moon sent back.
talk: Him. Clear as you. A body across the great crater, pale as chalk, burned black where the sun hit him, and a sword in his hand. And a little gold wreck in a crater nearby. Someone tried before you.

The old songs have a name I never understood until tonight. Iskar. The Silver King, who drove the moon by night the way the Chariot drove the sun by day. The songs say the Chariot killed him. I thought it was a metaphor.

Because the Faithful went, and they don't go anywhere for nothing. Because he's been lying there with nobody to bury him for a thousand years. And because that sword was made for one thing, and the thing it was made for is still out there.
A helmet that seals, and air to put in it. And fuel for the way home. Nobody ever plans for the way home. Promise me you will.
